intro: Jobs similar to fish and game wardens are law enforcement and outdoor conservation roles. By O*NET 31.0 data, the closest are Animal Control Workers (80% similar), Transit and Railroad Police (78%) and Police and Sheriff's Patrol Officers (78%).
shared: These careers share patrol work, enforcing rules and talking calmly with people who may not want to listen. O*NET rates judgment and decision making at 3.62 out of 5 for wardens. Police, forest technician and fire prevention jobs use the same field skills. 6 of the 20 are in the same law enforcement group, and several pay more than the $74,060 warden median.

faq.q: Which jobs like game warden pay more?
faq.a: 6 of the 20 similar careers pay more. Detectives and Criminal Investigators earn $93,790 (27% more), Transit and Railroad Police $90,230 (22% more) and Railroad Conductors and Yardmasters $78,000 (5% more), according to BLS May 2025 data, with no more preparation.

faq.q: What outdoor jobs are similar to game warden?
faq.a: Forest and Conservation Technicians are 77% similar and forest fire inspectors and prevention specialists 75%. Both keep you outdoors, but they earn less: $54,560 and $56,870, which are 26% and 23% below the game warden median, according to BLS May 2025 data.
